thread:
tomas: Heads up 1 — added my wife to coverage during open enrollment and got confirmation email, but the insurer's digital ID only shows me. We have a pediatrician visit tomorrow and they say they need dependent listed on card. What should I do?

lina (People Ops): Sorry that's stressful, @tomas. Two quick checks: confirm the insurer confirmation email has the dependent name and DOB, and grab the insurer enrollment confirmation number (usually in the subject or body). That number helps when calling the clinic.

tomas: I do have the insurer email that says "dependent enrolled" and an enrollment ref 8A19-3342. The digital ID PDF only shows my name and member ID.

broker-evan: This is usually a timing/roster sync issue. Many insurers backfill dependent info overnight. If you have the confirmation number, clinic can bill as if covered and then insurer will reprocess. If clinic insists on dependent being on the card, request they take a copy of the insurer confirmation email showing the dependent.

benefits-bot: Enrollment confirmation retrieved for Member 332210999: Enrollment Ref: 8A19-3342. Dependent: Maria T. DOB 2019-04-02. Coverage effective 2026-01-01. Digital ID PDF (member-only) will update after roster sync: https://portal.insurer/ids/332210999.pdf :card_file_box:

insurer-agent: Confirming: Dependent Maria T. added 2026-01-01 under Group RW-00011. Digital ID will be regenerated in 24-48 hours. For urgent visits, the clinic can accept the enrollment confirmation number + digital ID screenshot and we will process claims accordingly.

tomas: Clinic still wants a dependent listed. They said their EHR won't allow check-in without dependent ID. They asked for proof of enrollment and a signed waiver if we decline to pay now.

lina (People Ops): Two options: (A) ask the clinic to accept the enrollment email + a printed copy of the insurer confirmation (they often accept that as proof of coverage), (B) pay and submit for reimbursement if clinic refuses. If you pay, get an itemized receipt and the clinic's billing contact. We'll escalate with the insurer if needed.

broker-evan: If you want, I can call the insurer provider line now and request an immediate roster push to the clinic's payor portal. That sometimes updates the clinic eligibility in real time. Share clinic name and NPI.

tomas: Clinic is Parkview Pediatrics, NPI 1234567890. I don't want to pre-pay $240 for the visit if it's covered. Can broker call now?

broker-evan: I'll call insurer provider services and request an eligibility refresh for Parkview NPI 1234567890 and reference Enrollment Ref 8A19-3342. Expect 30-90m for portal to update depending on the clinic vendor. I'll update here once done.

benefits-bot: Noted: broker-evan will open a provider eligibility refresh ticket with insurer. Case ID: INS-77229. ETA 1-4 hours.

Parkview (Clinic) via tomas: Clinic said they will hold the patient on a "pending coverage" check but require a deposit for labs if any. They accepted a printed enrollment email as temporary proof for today.

insurer-agent: Update: provider portal refreshed for NPI 1234567890; dependent roster now visible. We will honor claims with service date 2026-02-02 and process as in-network. Please ensure clinic takes the enrollment ref + member digital ID PDF as backup.

lina (People Ops): Great news. Tomas, you should be all set. Quick checklist for you: (1) get an itemized receipt at check-out, (2) if any balance charged, pay by card and save receipt, (3) if they bill you later, forward any balance due + EOB to benefits@redwood.com and we'll assist.

tomas: Thank you all  Clinic accepted the printed enrollment email and the visit went fine. No labs. I grabbed a receipt just in case. Appreciate the fast response.

lina (People Ops): Closing note: if the digital ID still doesn't show dependent in 48h, reply here and we'll request a regenerated card or expedited paper ID. Also good to add dependent SSN to the insurer profile if missing 1 that sometimes blocks display on the card.

tomas: Will do  I'll check the portal tonight and follow up if needed. Thanks :tada:
